# docs.paypal.ai documentation — Developer

> 31 page(s) of docs.paypal.ai documentation under Developer. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Developer

- [Get started with PayPal REST APIs](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/get-started.md): Current PayPal APIs use REST, authenticate with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, and return HTTP response codes and JSON responses.
- [Handling API responses when integrating with PayPal APIs](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/handling-api-responses.md): Correctly processing API responses ensures that your application can gracefully manage successful payments, declines, errors, and edge cases.
- [Making PayPal REST API requests](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/make-api-requests.md): Build proper API requests with the correct headers and parameters to ensure successful communication with PayPal's REST APIs.
- [Rate limiting with PayPal REST APIs](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/rate-limiting.md): Rate limiting restricts the number of API requests you can make in a specific time frame.
- [Agreement already canceled](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/agreement-already-cancelled.md): Returns from the Orders V2 API.
- [Cannot pay self](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/cannot-pay-self.md): Returns from the Payments V1 API.
- [Currency mismatch](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/currency-mismatch.md): Returns from the Payments V2 API.
- [Currency not allowed](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/currency-not-allowed.md): Returns from the Payments V1 API.
- [Duplicate transactions](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/duplicate-transaction.md): Returns from the Payments V2 API.
- [Merchant not enabled for reference transaction](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/merchant-not-enabled-for-reference-transaction.md): Returns from the Payments V1 API.
- [Not authorized](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/not-authorized.md): The Orders v2 API returns a `403 Not Authorized` error when the API caller or the payee does not have permission. Review the common causes and how to fix them.
- [Common errors overview](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/overview.md): Troubleshooting is an important part of integrating with the PayPal Orders API.
- [Resource not found](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/resource-not-found.md): A `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` error occurs when the specified resource does not exist. The following issues can cause this error.
- [Unprocessable entity](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/unprocessable-entity.md): PayPal cannot process your request because it is incorrect or fails business rules. The issues below can cause an `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` error.
- [Unsupported payee currency](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/unsupported-payee-currency.md): Returns from the Payments V1 API.
- [Validation error](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/common-errors/validation-error.md): You get a validation error when the API request contains invalid, missing, or incorrectly formatted data.
- [Handling payment failures with PayPal](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/api/troubleshooting/handling-payment-failures-with-paypal.md): Detect and respond to payment failures using PayPal's Orders v2 API and Subscriptions API.
- [Apps, scopes, and credentials](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/apps-scopes-credentials.md): PayPal Apps are registered apps within the PayPal Developer ecosystem that verify and authorize your software to interact with PayPal's services.
- [Advanced configuration](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/sdk/js/v6/advanced.md): Advanced configuration options for the JavaScript SDK v6 help you customize the payment experience.
- [Button color updates](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/sdk/js/v6/button-color-updates.md): PayPal button color updates require no JavaScript SDK integration changes.
- [Set up JavaScript SDK v6](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/sdk/js/v6/configuration.md): The PayPal JavaScript SDK v6 enables you to accept the following payment methods on your website:
- [Sandboxed <iframe> integration](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/sdk/js/v6/iframe.md): PayPal's sandboxed `<iframe>` integration provides enhanced security by isolating payment processing code within a secure `<iframe>` wrapper while maintaining seamless…
- [Test and go live](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/sdk/js/v6/production.md): Before you go live with the JavaScript SDK v6, test your integration end to end, and confirm you've completed all items in the production checklist.
- [PayPal security guidelines for developers](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/how-to/security-guidelines.md): Creating strong, secure payment systems keeps both your app and your customers' private information safe.
- [Agent toolkit quickstart guide](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/tools/ai/agent-toolkit-quickstart.md): PayPal's agent toolkit supports the integration of PayPal APIs into AI agent workflows using <a href="https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/">Amazon Bedrock</a>, <a…
- [Agent tools reference](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/tools/ai/agent-tools-ref.md): PayPal's <a href="/developer/tools/ai/agent-toolkit-quickstart">agent toolkit</a> includes the following tools.
- [PayPal's AI resources for developers](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/tools/ai/ai-intro.md): Using AI is a powerful way to enhance your applications and services. Everyday examples include:
- [LLM integration quickstart guide](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/tools/ai/llm-integration.md): PayPal recently launched a <a href="https://www.paypal.ai/tools/mcp-quickstart">Model Context Protocol (MCP) server</a> that customers can use to access the power of PayPal using…
- [MCP server quickstart guide](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/tools/ai/mcp-quickstart.md): [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/introduction?wt.mc_id=studentamb_263805) makes it easier to manage and send information to models.
- [Best practices for prompts](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/tools/ai/prompt-best-practices.md): Build effective prompts that unlock the full potential of PayPal AI agents with these tips.
- [Upgrade from v5](https://docs.paypal.ai/developer/upgrade/sdk/js/v5-v6.md): Use this guide to upgrade your PayPal integration from the JavaScript SDK v5 to the JavaScript SDK v6.
